archetypes.name: bash-portability
archetypes.rationale: The diff adds Bash entrypoints and harness logic that must remain compatible with the repo's macOS Bash 3.2 baseline.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the changed shell scripts and harness additions for Bash 3.2 portability and safe behavior under set -euo pipefail. Pay special attention to direct-execution guards, command substitution failure paths, mktemp usage, env -u invocation, arrays, and assumptions about $0 versus BASH_SOURCE. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: cli-contracts
archetypes.rationale: The change modifies structured CLI envelopes and env propagation that downstream orchestrators parse and depend on.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the runtime CLI contracts for append-execution-issue.sh, implement-bootstrap-invoke.sh, and lib-implement-round-cap.sh. Check that stdout, stderr, exit codes, exported environment, and failure envelopes remain consistent with documented consumers and do not introduce ambiguous parser behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-wiring
archetypes.rationale: New regression coverage is only useful if Makefile sharding and agent-lint reachability metadata are wired correctly.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Makefile shard additions, .PHONY entries, new harness stubs, and agent-lint excludes for reachability and maintenance hazards. Look for duplicate or missing target registration, shard coverage drift, dead-script lint mismatches, and harnesses that would not run under the intended relevant checks path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: skill-prose
archetypes.rationale: The implementation skill prose is executable operator guidance, so small wording changes can alter /implement Step 5 behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the skills/implement/SKILL.md change as runtime orchestration guidance rather than ordinary documentation. Check whether the new degraded-round CLI directive is actionable in the existing Step 5 flow, preserves the no-new-fence intent, and aligns with the helper's current arguments and output. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
